name: SaveAllGroups
title: Templates/Platform/Forms/SaveAllGroups
summary: Account-level settings as `Item` rows saved as one unit: the platform shell with an unpadded scroll region, the form column opening with a small page heading, topic sections each a small heading over a flush `Card` of rows, and one full-bleed sticky footer with Cancel and Save. Profile is the example, with General (Full Name, Email), Preferences (Timezone, Language) and Notifications (Product updates). Full Name and Email flag only after Save is pressed. Built from `PageHeader`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, the platform shell, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch`, `HelperText` and `Button`.

variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: While the save is in flight: the whole fieldset is disabled, Cancel is disabled and Save shows its loading state.
